issue.title: gateway: kimiToolRefTypes writes a type beside a $ref whose target is {format, description, $ref}
issue.body:
Found while fixing magpie-community/plugins#287 (kimi-work: Codex tools refused as "not a valid moonshot flavored json schema").

`kimiToolRefTypes` (internal/gateway/kimi_schema.go:266) writes a `type` into each schema its tools reference. When the referenced definition is itself `{format, description, $ref}` (a ref to a ref), a `type` ends up beside the `$ref`, which Moonshot's schema check refuses. The plugin side was fixed in kimi-work 0.1.5; magpie's own Kimi path still has this.

To do: resolve the chain to the final target before choosing a type (or leave a `$ref` node without a sibling `type`), with a test built from Codex's real tool schemas that is red on the current code.

comments.body:
## Summary

`kimiToolRefTypes` (internal/gateway/kimi_schema.go) wrote a `type` into every schema a tool's `$ref`s reach that has none. When the reached target was itself a `$ref` — zod writes one beside what it changed of a reused schema, a `format` and a `description` among them — that `type` landed beside the inner `$ref`, which Moonshot's "moonshot flavored json schema" check refuses with 400 "At path '$defs.__schema14': when using $ref, type should be defined in the referenced schema instead of the parent schema", and the whole request fails. The chain a `$ref` names is now followed to the schema it ends at, and the type, if one is due, is written there — or nowhere when the chain ends at a ref to nowhere or never ends.

## Why this shape of fix

Of the two directions in the issue, resolving the chain to the final target fits what is already there: `schemaTypes` has been resolving `$ref` chains to decide *what* the type is, so only the place the type is *written* moves. Leaving every `$ref` node without a sibling type instead would also leave the chain's final target untyped when nothing else reaches it, which is the "detected infinite recursion without termination condition" refusal this function exists for.

## Verification

Tested with Codex's real `automation_update` tool schema — the captured fixture `internal/provider/testdata/codex_automation_update_schema.json` (ChatGPT.app 26.930's zod output), whose `targetThreadId` reaches `{"format":"uuid","description":"tt","$ref":"#/$defs/__schema1"}`; `__schema1` is `{"type":"string","minLength":1}`. The new test `TestKimiToolRefTypesRefChain` sends it through the gateway to a fake Kimi upstream and asserts Moonshot's rule as an invariant: no schema that goes out may carry a `type` beside a `$ref`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `go test ./internal/gateway/ -run TestKimiToolRefTypesRefChain` on 9b0f4861 (before the fix) | FAIL — "Kimi was sent a type beside a $ref ... `{"type":"string","format":"uuid","description":"tt","$ref":"#/$defs/__schema1"}`" |
| same after the fix | ok |
| ablation: kimi_schema.go restored to 9b0f4861, test kept | FAIL again, same output |
| fix re-applied | ok |
| `go test ./internal/gateway/ -count=1 -tags nogui` (whole package) | ok |
| `gofmt -l internal/gateway/` | empty |
| `go vet ./...` | exit 0 (only a pre-existing cgo warning in internal/gui/trayimage_darwin.go) |
| `GOOS=linux go vet -tags nogui ./...` | exit 0 |
| `GOOS=windows go vet -tags nogui ./...` | exit 0 |
| `GOOS=darwin go build -tags nogui ./...` | exit 0 |
| `GOOS=linux go build -tags nogui ./...` | exit 0 |
| `GOOS=windows go build -tags nogui ./...` | exit 0 |

After the fix Codex's schema goes through byte for byte: every def in it is notes beside a `$ref` to the typed `__schema1`, which Kimi takes as it is.

## Not verified

- Against the real Moonshot/Kimi API: no credentials on this machine. The 400 wording the assertions encode is the one recorded from a real refusal in kimi-work 0.1.5's tests (magpie-community/plugins#287), the plugin-side fix of the same bug.
- `kimiToolEnumTypes` would also write a type beside a `$ref` for a combined `{$ref, enum}` schema, which JSON Schema allows; no known client sends that shape (zod and Codex do not produce it) and the issue does not report one, so it is left as it was.

**Attribution**: AI-written; I've read the whole diff and the tests pass. Please keep the author (`ggbdpq`) or add `Co-authored-by: ggbdpq <ggbdpq@gmail.com>`.

Branch with the commit: [hunt59-c-3205-kimi-reftype](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/tree/hunt59-c-3205-kimi-reftype) (head `4b3b8083a19bc26b27af746ebc91d208eb53f645`).

Adopted @ggbdpq's patch [4b3b8083](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/commit/4b3b8083a19bc26b27af746ebc91d208eb53f645) in my fork, with `Co-authored-by: ggbdpq <ggbdpq@gmail.com>` preserved: [f5ec664](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/f5ec664), branch [`fix/kimi-ref-chain`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/kimi-ref-chain).

The Kimi normalizer follows a local `$ref` chain before inserting a type. Intermediate reference schemas retain their format/description; a missing type belongs at the terminal target. Dangling or cyclic chains remain unchanged, as do schemas sent to other providers.

I reproduced the failure with the retained Codex automation_update fixture: old code sends `type: string` beside `$defs.__schema14`'s `$ref`. The retained gateway regression and added terminal-target, dangling, cyclic and non-Kimi cases pass with Go 1.26.8, `-race -count=3`; the existing protocol-route coverage remains green.

Integrated at [3833e3f3](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/3833e3f36e37ee851d78b033cd8b27fb7e14dd5a): native/Linux nogui/Windows vet and builds, plus the full `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m`, all pass under an isolated HOME and umask 027.

No live Kimi/Moonshot request was made; fake transport captures the outgoing schema. No upstream PR opened.

Verified — `f5ec664b` carries my 4b3b8083's product change byte for byte (`git diff 4b3b8083 f5ec664b -- internal/gateway/kimi_schema.go` is empty), with `Co-authored-by: ggbdpq` preserved, plus ~100 lines of regression tests and the routing-doc note my patch didn't have.

Checked the branch out and re-ran it: the added `TestKimiToolRefTypesRefChain` and `TestKimiToolRefTypesChainTargets` cases (terminal target, dangling ref, cycle) fail with the product file reverted and pass with it back — chain shapes my own tests only partially locked. `kimi_schema.go` has no drift between the branch's base (`7aad6a50`) and the current tip (`398803e3`), so it applies clean whenever you pick it up; the fix is still missing from main.

Thanks for the credit and for locking the chain shapes down.

Verified with AI assistance (GLM-5.3-Flash via ZCode); I've read the diff and re-ran the checks above.
Landed in **v0.1.2520** from gua's patch (ggbdpq) as written, with the Kimi rule scoped to Kimi. The push closed this. 7bdf08f18. Run: ./internal/gateway on mote. Not tried with a real Kimi account.

+		if !t.IsObject() || t.Index <= 0 || t.Index >= len(body) || body[t.Index] != '{' || !untypedForKimi(t) {

+// A $ref whose target is itself a $ref goes without a type beside it:
+// Moonshot refuses one there, 400 "At path '$defs.__schema14': when using
+// $ref, type should be defined in the referenced schema instead of the
+// parent schema" (#3205), and the whole request fails. Codex writes such
+// defs beside what it changed of a reused one — its automation_update's
+// targetThreadId reaches {"format":"uuid","description":"tt","$ref":
+// "#/$defs/__schema1"} (the fixture is what ChatGPT.app 26.930's zod
+// builds) — so the chain is resolved to the final target and the type, if
+// one is due, is written there; __schema1 has a type, so the def goes as
+// Codex sent it.
+func TestKimiToolRefTypesRefChain(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", t.TempDir())
+	t.Setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", t.TempDir())
+	kimi, err := provider.FromPreset("kimi-code-cn")

+	if err != nil {

+	got := map[string]string{}
+	s := New()
+	s.client = &http.Client{Transport: countTransport(func(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {

+		got[r.URL.Host+r.URL.Path] = string(b)
+		return &http.Response{StatusCode: 200, Header: http.Header{"Content-Type": {"application/json"}},
+			Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(`{"id":"c","object":"chat.completion","model":"m","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"ok"},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}`))}, nil
+	})}
+	body := `{"model":"kimi/m","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],` +
+		`"tools":[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"mcp__codex_app__automation_update","parameters":` + string(schema) + `}}]}`
+	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
+	s.Handler().ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/v1/chat/completions", strings.NewReader(body)))
+	if rec.Code != 200 {
+		t.Fatalf("%d %s", rec.Code, rec.Body)
+	}
+	b := got["api.kimi.com/coding/v1/chat/completions"]
+	if b == "" {
+		t.Fatal("nothing was sent to Kimi")
+	}
+	if !json.Valid([]byte(b)) {

+	}

+	if !sent.Exists() {

+	}

+	// no type beside a $ref anywhere in the schema as it goes.
+	var besideRef []string

+			besideRef = append(besideRef, s.Raw)

+	} else {

+		if err := json.Compact(&buf, []byte(def.Raw)); err != nil {

+		}
+		if buf.String() != `{"format":"uuid","description":"tt","$ref":"#/$defs/__schema1"}` {
+			t.Errorf("Codex's format-and-$ref def was rewritten:\n%s", def.Raw)

Adopted @ggbdpq's patch [4b3b8083](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/commit/4b3b8083a19bc26b27af746ebc91d208eb53f645) in my fork, with `Co-authored-by: ggbdpq <ggbdpq@gmail.com>` preserved: [f5ec664](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/f5ec664), branch [`fix/kimi-ref-chain`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/kimi-ref-chain).

The Kimi normalizer follows a local `$ref` chain before inserting a type. Intermediate reference schemas retain their format/description; a missing type belongs at the terminal target. Dangling or cyclic chains remain unchanged, as do schemas sent to other providers.

I reproduced the failure with the retained Codex automation_update fixture: old code sends `type: string` beside `$defs.__schema14`'s `$ref`. The retained gateway regression and added terminal-target, dangling, cyclic and non-Kimi cases pass with Go 1.26.8, `-race -count=3`; the existing protocol-route coverage remains green.

Integrated at [3833e3f3](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/3833e3f36e37ee851d78b033cd8b27fb7e14dd5a): native/Linux nogui/Windows vet and builds, plus the full `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m`, all pass under an isolated HOME and umask 027.

No live Kimi/Moonshot request was made; fake transport captures the outgoing schema. No upstream PR opened.

Verified — `f5ec664b` carries my 4b3b8083's product change byte for byte (`git diff 4b3b8083 f5ec664b -- internal/gateway/kimi_schema.go` is empty), with `Co-authored-by: ggbdpq` preserved, plus ~100 lines of regression tests and the routing-doc note my patch didn't have.

Checked the branch out and re-ran it: the added `TestKimiToolRefTypesRefChain` and `TestKimiToolRefTypesChainTargets` cases (terminal target, dangling ref, cycle) fail with the product file reverted and pass with it back — chain shapes my own tests only partially locked. `kimi_schema.go` has no drift between the branch's base (`7aad6a50`) and the current tip (`398803e3`), so it applies clean whenever you pick it up; the fix is still missing from main.

Thanks for the credit and for locking the chain shapes down.

Verified with AI assistance (GLM-5.3-Flash via ZCode); I've read the diff and re-ran the checks above.

issue.title: [Bug] gateway/Kimi: typed $ref target containing an untyped object oneOf still causes schema rejection

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 问题

Magpie 的 Kimi Code 路线能处理 `$ref` 直接指向无类型 `oneOf` 的简单情况，但下面这种**已声明类型的引用目标内部再包含无类型 oneOf**仍返回：

```text
400 Kimi Code (China): tools.function.parameters is not a valid moonshot flavored json schema,
details: <At path 'properties.x': detected infinite recursion without termination condition>
```

最小复现没有引用循环。只给内部 union 补 `type: object`，相同路线返回 200 / OK。

关联：[WorkBuddy 插件 #378 的三路实测补充](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/issues/378#issuecomment-6394043743)。本 issue 聚焦 Magpie 自身的 `kimi-code-cn` 网关路径；WorkBuddy/Qoder 插件的整理逻辑由插件仓库处理。

## 最小请求

发送到已配置 Kimi Code 的 Magpie 网关 `POST /v1/chat/completions`：

```json
{
  "model": "kimi-code-cn/k3.1-pro",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Do not call tools. Reply exactly OK."}],
  "tools": [{
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
      "name": "probe",
      "description": "Diagnostic placeholder.",
      "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {"x": {"$ref": "#/$defs/X"}},
        "$defs": {
          "X": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "y": {
                "oneOf": [
                  {"type": "object", "properties": {"mode": {"type": "string", "const": "a"}}},
                  {"type": "object", "properties": {"mode": {"type": "string", "const": "b"}}}
                ]
              }
            },
            "required": ["y"]
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }],
  "max_tokens": 32000,
  "reasoning_effort": "high",
  "stream": false
}
```

唯一改动：给 `tools[0].function.parameters.$defs.X.properties.y` 加 `"type": "object"`。原始请求 400，修改后 200 / OK；将 `X` 内联、移除这次引用，也能成功。

## 实际 dsh 验证

2026-10-25，以 `dsh headless 0.2.1-rc.2` 运行完整 REA 工具集，共 198 个工具，其中 170 个 REA 工具：

- 原始工具集：Kimi Code 返回 400，错误位置 `properties.after_scenario`，dsh 退出码 1。
- 在临时诊断请求中给 object-only 的无类型 oneOf 补类型：200，最终回复 `OK`，dsh 退出码 0，持久化 session 为 `completed`。
- 实际路由已由网关记录确认是 `kimi-code-cn`，返回模型为 `k3.1-pro`。
- 最终规则在这份工具集中命中 55 处，涉及 29 个工具；含仅接受直接 object 分支的 54 处版本时，Kimi Code 已成功。第 55 处是本地引用分支，对 WorkBuddy/Qoder 插件路径也必要。

原始工具定位为 `mcp__rea__compare_web_captures`。`after_scenario` 的引用目标自身已有 object 类型，但其后代 `steps → items → artifacts` 中有未声明类型的 object union。对完整 compare 工具补齐 12 个同类节点后，单工具请求也成功。

## 当前源码线索

检查时 main 为 `1b039a3c7247d0221fb0b8ed8ef89a35ffd8e9d6`：

- [`collectRefTargets`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/1b039a3c7247d0221fb0b8ed8ef89a35ffd8e9d6/internal/gateway/kimi_schema.go#L289) 按 `$ref` 查找直接目标。
- 直接目标已有 type 时，`untypedForKimi` 将其排除；目标内部未被另一个 `$ref` 单独引用的无类型 union，未由这个动作补类型。

本次测试时 Magpie 安装文件为 0.1.1485，未重启网关，运行中进程的精确版号未单独确认。上述 main 源码是独立只读检查，未把它当成运行中进程的源码证明。实网失败/成功对照发生在同一运行环境。

## 与 #3205 的区别

[#3205](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3205) 处理 `{format, description, $ref}` 引用链中间节点被错误添加 type 的问题。本复现的 `X` 已明确为 object，没有引用链中间节点，也不需要在 `$ref` 旁增加 type；缺失的是内部 `y.oneOf` 的 type。因此应单独跟踪，但两个修复需要互相保护。

## 建议验收

1. 覆盖“直接引用无类型 union”和“typed 引用目标内部的无类型 union”。
2. 仅在各分支均明确为 object 时补 object 类型；本地引用需检查缺失和循环，不向引用链中间节点插类型。
3. 保留 anyOf、混合类型 union、examples/default 和非 Kimi 路线的既有语义。
4. 最小复现及真实 REA schema 均做回归；正式版本再跑完整 dsh 会话。

测试只修改工作目录内的诊断请求，没有更改现有配置或插件。现有 34 个配置、插件及程序文件校验和保持一致。本次验证工具声明和文本回合，没有实际执行 REA 工具或验证多轮调用。
